picks.title: Meta's New Terms Expand Crawling Rights Beyond Advertisers
picks.rationale: Meta's new commercial terms take effect Oct 30. Any business tied to a Facebook or Instagram account grants AI-training crawl rights over its site, and Meta links this to AI product ads. Advertisers need to decide what to do before the deadline.
picks.excerpt: Meta's new commercial terms, effective Oct 30, let it crawl any site tied to a Facebook or Instagram business account and use the content to train its AI products, widening rights ad buyers had already granted. Meta says the purpose is product data, which ties it to AI product ads and shopping. The Verge and PPC Land also covered it.

picks.title: Google begins testing ads in AI Mode for users with Personal Intelligence enabled
picks.rationale: Google is reversing the ad-free Personal Intelligence experience and testing personalized ads in AI Mode, which opens a new paid surface in AI search.
picks.excerpt: Google is reversing the ad-free Personal Intelligence experience and testing AI Mode ads that can be personalized with insights from connected Google apps. Ads won't be based directly on Gmail or Photos content, and advertisers get no access to connected-app data. Facts come from the SEL RSS full text because the article HTML is blocked.

picks.title: ChatGPT Ads introduces new measurement tools and visual ad formats
picks.rationale: This is a new release: six named MMM and attribution partners, a redesigned Conversions page, weekly performance emails, and tests of larger images and a multi-image format. It changes how buyers measure ChatGPT spend.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI is adding Northbeam, DV Rockerbox and INCRMNTAL plus Kochava, Tenjin and Airbridge as measurement partners, redesigning the Ads Manager Conversions page, sending weekly performance emails, and testing larger images, wider ad cards and a multi-image format. Article HTML is blocked; facts come from the SEL RSS full text.

picks.title: How ChatGPT Targets Ads To You Based On Your Prompts, Phone Number, and Email
picks.rationale: This reporting is the first to show that ChatGPT advertisers can target users by uploaded email, phone number or mobile ad ID on top of prompt context. That is a targeting capability no published card has covered.
picks.excerpt: 404 Media reports that advertisers can target ChatGPT users by uploaded email address, phone number or mobile ad ID, on top of prompt context, which most users likely don't realize. This is an off-list outlet: AdExchanger's roundup cites it and no on-list outlet covered it.

picks.title: Thrad commits $1m in ad spend to AI chat apps testing in-chat ads
picks.rationale: Thrad's DSP will route $1M of advertiser spend to consumer AI apps that test contextual in-chat ads, double its first round. This extends conversational ad inventory beyond ChatGPT.
picks.excerpt: Thrad's Monetization Fund II routes up to $1 million in advertiser campaigns through its DSP to consumer AI apps willing to test in-chat ads, double the $500,000 first round. Ads are matched to the conversation topic rather than a user profile and appear as disclosed native sponsored placements.

https://searchengineland.com/chatgpt-ads.new_action: OpenAI's Oct 16 release adds six named measurement partners (Northbeam, DV Rockerbox, INCRMNTAL, Kochava, Tenjin, Airbridge), a redesigned Ads Manager Conversions page and weekly performance emails, and starts tests of larger-image, wider-card and multi-image formats. None of this was in the Oct 7 announcement.
